lead: Rajiv Ranjan Singh is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 24 January 1955 in Patna.
As of 2026, he is 71 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha.
